pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. A minimal three-day timeline: EXACTLY THREE equal blank calendar day cards in one horizontal row, each with one small yellow sun at top, no dates. The MIDDLE card is the fixed TODAY reference: a solid blue dot immediately below its center and a thin blue vertical line linking the dot to that middle card. ONLY the MIDDLE (SECOND), meaning TODAY card is pale red with a bold red outline and one red downward arrow above it. Other cards white with gray outlines. Read left-to-right: previous day, current day, next day. Precisely distinguish selected MIDDLE (SECOND), meaning TODAY day from the blue middle-day reference. The whole three-card strip and all arrows fully visible. No people, no labels, no writing or numbers.  Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
